description: This file defines an Angular component for a timeline UI in a software project that visualizes trace data, timestamps, and associated video content with interactive controls.

classes.name: TimelineComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying and interacting with a timeline visualization of trace data and related media.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle method to initialize timeline component, set video URL if available.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Lifecycle method to emit collapsed timeline height after view initialization.

methods.name: getVideoCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns current video playback time in seconds aligned with the trace position.

methods.name: getCurrentTracePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current trace position, considering seek timestamp fallback.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Handler for external trace position updates, updates input fields accordingly.

methods.name: toggleExpand
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of the timeline view.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the timeline data with a new trace position.

methods.name: usingRealtime
methods.description: Determines if the timeline uses real-time timestamps.

methods.name: updateSeekTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the current seek timestamp and refreshes input fields.

methods.name: updateTimeInputValuesToCurrentTimestamp
methods.description: Synchronizes input controls with current trace timestamp.

methods.name: isOptionDisabled
methods.description: Checks whether a trace type option should be disabled in the selection UI.

methods.name: onTraceSelectionClosed
methods.description: Handles trace selection dialog close event, updates selected traces.

methods.name: applyNewTraceSelection
methods.description: Applies the trace selection from the form control to internal state.

methods.name: handleKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation using arrow keys.

methods.name: hasPrevEntry
methods.description: Checks if there is a previous trace entry available.

methods.name: hasNextEntry
methods.description: Checks if there is a next trace entry available.

methods.name: moveToPreviousEntry
methods.description: Moves the trace position to the previous entry.

methods.name: moveToNextEntry
methods.description: Moves the trace position to the next entry.

methods.name: humanElapsedTimeInputChange
methods.description: Parses and applies elapsed human-readable timestamp input.

methods.name: humanRealTimeInputChanged
methods.description: Parses and applies real-time human-readable timestamp input.

methods.name: nanosecondsInputTimeChange
methods.description: Parses and applies nanosecond timestamp input.
